items.title: Yanic Konan Niederhäuser is set to make his season debut tomorrow in San Antonio. He returns after missing eight months with a Lisfranc injury. In his last five games, he averaged 8.2 points, 6.2 rebounds, 2.2 blocks and that included just eight minutes vs Indy when he got hurt.
